designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a first-party desktop data application experience characterized by calm white content sheets, floating frosted glass controls, and physics-driven motion. The visual style bridges Glassmorphism and refined minimalism, relying on translucent layers, soft ambient shadows, and crisp typography to create a serene, professional environment.

- **Brand Personality:** Calm, precise, reliable, and deeply polished.
- **Target Audience:** Data analysts, financial professionals, and power users who demand high information density without visual fatigue.
- **Emotional Response:** Trust, clarity, effortless control, and modern sophistication.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model relies on floating glass islands suspended over a calm solid white background sheet. 

- **Floating Islands:** Control layers float 10px in from window edges with consistent 10px gaps between islands, allowing content sheets to scroll smoothly underneath.
- **Grid Structure:** A dense, structured layout rhythm using 12px gutters and precise padding scales ensures high information density without clutter.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is articulated through a strict separation of layers: solid, opaque content surfaces sit below floating frosted glass control planes.

- **Glass Surfaces:** Controls feature 24px background blur, saturate 1.6, a 1px exterior white rim (`rgba(255,255,255,0.75)`), an inner top highlight (`rgba(255,255,255,0.9)`), and diffused shadows (`0 8px 32px rgba(15,23,42,0.10)`).
- **Layering Rules:** Never layer glass directly on glass; submenus and nested dropdown panels render as solid white surfaces to maintain legibility.

## Components

Components are designed for desktop precision, responsive spring animations, and strict functional clarity.

- **Menu Bar & Menus:** A slim glass strip hosting 30px menu items complete with icons, labels, right-aligned shortcuts in tertiary text, and chevrons for submenus. Submenus open as solid white panels to avoid glass-on-glass stacking.
- **Toolbar:** A floating glass island featuring icon-above-label buttons (18px Lucide icons with 1.5px stroke, 11px labels). Groups are separated by 12px gaps and faint 1px dividers, with soft round-rect hover fills and teal washes for active tools.
- **Data Grid:** Solid white surface featuring 30px rows, horizontal-only hairlines, row-number gutters in tertiary text, and a distinctive selection range bounded by a 2px teal ring with 4px corners, soft teal fill, and a small round fill handle. Selected column and row headers are tinted.
- **Inspector:** A floating glass panel (300px wide) anchored to the right edge, featuring a segmented control track (glass track with solid white thumb) and uppercase tertiary section titles.
- **Sheet Tabs & Status Bar:** A combined bottom glass strip housing pill-shaped sheet tabs (active pill in solid white with soft shadow), live aggregate selection figures (Sum, Average, Count), and a GPU status chip with a live green indicator dot.
- **Dialogs & Sheets:** Centered solid white panels with 20px radii and deep soft shadows, presented over dimmed, blurred window backdrops. Features 17px 600 weight titles, primary teal pill buttons, and quiet secondary pills.
- **Report Tiles:** White cards with 16px radii, secondary label text, large numbers (34px), and filter chips. Top-right remove buttons appear dynamically on hover.

# omxplorer · Liquid (light) — the showcase skin

A desktop data app that feels like a first-party Mac app: a calm white sheet, the controls floating above it on frosted glass, everything moving on springs. Liquid's two layers: **content is solid, controls are glass.**

## Colour (exact values)
- Window backdrop behind everything: a very soft cool gradient #eef2f7 → #e6ebf2 (top to bottom).
- Content layer (solid, opaque): sheet, tables, cards, report page #ffffff. Raised rows / header row #f6f8fb. Hairline rgba(15,23,42,0.07). Strong line rgba(15,23,42,0.14).
- Control layer (glass): toolbar, menu bar, inspector, sheet tabs, status bar, menus, popovers, dialogs: rgba(255,255,255,0.62) with 24px background blur and saturate 1.6, a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.75) rim, a 1px inner top highlight rgba(255,255,255,0.9) and shadow 0 8px 32px rgba(15,23,42,0.10), 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06).
- Ink #0f172a · Body #334155 · Secondary #64748b · Tertiary #94a3b8.
- One accent, omxplorer's deep teal: #0e7c86 (hover #0b6870), wash rgba(14,124,134,0.10), selection fill rgba(14,124,134,0.08), text on accent #ffffff.
- Formula values #6a4fd6. Good #16a34a. Bad #dc2626. Warning #d97706.
- Chart series in order: #0e7c86, #f59e0b, #6366f1, #ec4899, #22c55e, #a16207, #64748b, #c026d3.

## Type
- Inter everywhere (it reads like SF Pro), tabular figures for every number. JetBrains Mono only for formulas and the formula bar.
- 13px body, 12px captions, 11px toolbar labels (500), 15px section titles (600), 22px page titles (700, -0.3px tracking), 34px for the one big number on a tile (650).
- Two weights per screen besides titles: 400 and 500.

## Shape (concentric)
- Window 14px. Floating glass islands 18px with 6px inner padding, so buttons inside are 12px. Cards and report tiles 16px. Menus 14px with 6px padding, items 8px. Inputs and dropdowns 10px. Chips, toggles, segmented thumbs, icon buttons: fully round. Table cells 0; the selection ring 4px.
- Islands float 10px in from the window edges with 10px between them; content scrolls under them.

## Components
- **Menu bar:** a slim glass strip, 13px items, every menu the same type; menus open as one glass panel (never glass on glass: a submenu is a solid white panel), items 30px with icon, label, shortcut right-aligned in tertiary text, a chevron for submenus.
- **Toolbar:** one floating glass island, icon-above-label buttons (18px Lucide icons, 1.5px stroke, 11px labels), groups separated by 12px of space and a faint 1px divider; hover shows a soft round-rect fill; the active tool a teal wash. Left: Save, Undo. Middle: the tab's tools. Right: Format.
- **Grid:** solid white, header row with name, a small round type badge and a tiny histogram; 30px rows; hairlines only horizontal; a row-number gutter in tertiary text; the selected range has a 2px teal ring with 4px corners, a soft teal fill and a small round fill handle; selected column/row headers tinted.
- **Inspector:** a floating glass panel on the right, 300px, a segmented control (glass track, solid white thumb) for its tabs; sections with small uppercase tertiary titles.
- **Sheet tabs and status bar:** one slim glass strip at the bottom: tabs as pills (active pill solid white with a soft shadow), then live figures for the selection (Sum, Average, Count), the GPU chip with a green dot.
- **Dialog / sheet:** a centred solid white panel, 20px radius, large soft shadow, over a dimmed and blurred window; title 17px 600, primary button a teal pill, secondary a quiet pill.
- **Report tile:** a white card, 16px radius, label in secondary text, the big number, the filter as a small chip; tiles sit in a tidy grid of equal widths, the remove button inside the top-right corner, visible on hover.

## Motion (springs, never linear)
- Snappy spring (430 ms) for hover, press (scale 0.96) and toggles; bouncy spring (790 ms) for things that arrive (a menu, a dialog, a new tile); gentle spring (710 ms) for layout changes (the inspector sliding in, tiles reflowing). The selection ring glides between cells.

screens.prompt:
Desktop screen (1440x900) for 'omxplorer', a first-party Mac-feel data app under the Liquid light theme.

Window background:
- Cool gradient #eef2f7 to #e6ebf2 with top-left macOS window traffic lights (red, yellow, green dots).
- Underneath the modal, the app window is visible but dimmed and frosted with backdrop blur:
  - Top glass menu bar (omxplorer, File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Data, Window, Help) floating 10px in.
  - Floating glass toolbar with Lucide-style icon buttons (Save, Undo, Sort, Filter, Pivot, Chart, Format).
  - Background grid sheet showing faint data table with row numbers, and status bar at bottom with sheet tabs ('Sheet 1', 'Sheet 2') and live figures (Sum, Average, GPU chip with green dot).
  - Semi-transparent backdrop overlay: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.25) with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-md) dimming the background workspace.

Import Modal Dialog:
- Centered solid white floating panel, exactly 1100px wide by 760px high, 20px border radius, crisp 1px border rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), deep soft elevation shadow (0 24px 64px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.22), 0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,0.06)).
- All typography strictly in Inter, with tabular figures for numbers.

Modal Header:
- Top padding, clean flex layout.
- Left side: Title 'Import sales-1m.parquet' (22px Inter, 700 weight, -0.3px tracking, ink #0f172a).
- Subtitle right below: '1,000,000 rows · 5 columns · read in 0.02 s' where 'read in 0.02 s' is in vivid good green (#16a34a) with a small lightning/sparkle or check indicator, and rows/columns in secondary slate (#64748b, 12px Inter tabular figures).
- Right side: Concentric 3-step progress control / breadcrumb pill: 'File › Columns › Table' inside a soft glass/subtle track:
  - Step 1 'File': completed (muted slate with checkmark or quiet icon, #64748b).
  - Divider: '›' (#94a3b8).
  - Step 2 'Columns': CURRENT active step (accentuated pill badge in omxplorer deep teal #0e7c86 with white text, font weight 600, px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs).
  - Divider: '›' (#94a3b8).
  - Step 3 'Table': upcoming step (tertiary text #94a3b8, text-xs).

Section 1: Data Preview Grid (first 9 rows):
- Section label: 'Preview (First 9 rows)' (12px uppercase font-semibold tracking-wider text-slate-500 mb-2).
- Solid white container with 1px border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm.
- Table headers with column names: 'order', 'amount', 'region', 'day', 'paid'.
- Each column header includes:
  - Column name (13px 600 weight Inter).
  - A small concentric type badge next to or under the name:
    - 'order': '#' (integer badge, soft gray wash).
    - 'amount': '0.0' (decimal badge, soft blue/teal wash).
    - 'region': 'Aa' (text badge, soft slate wash).
    - 'day': 'date' (calendar/date icon or 'date' pill).
    - 'paid': 'bool' (toggle/bool badge).
  - A tiny distribution histogram chart right in the header row (32px wide by 12px tall mini sparkline/bars).
- 9 clean rows (32px row height, tabular numbers, Inter 13px, horizontal hairlines rgba(15,23,42,0.07)):
  - Row number gutter in muted tertiary text (1 to 9).
  - Realistic data values:
    - order: 10001, 10002, 10003, 10004, 10005, 10006, 10007, 10008, 10009.
    - amount: $428.50, [empty cell with dashed placeholder or faint amber null pill], $1,280.00, $89.90, [empty cell], $2,450.25, $310.00, $745.10, $512.40.
    - region: 'EMEA', 'APAC', 'Americas', 'EMEA', 'Americas', 'APAC', 'EMEA', 'Americas', 'APAC'.
    - day: 2024-03-01, 2024-03-01, 2024-03-02, 2024-03-02, 2024-03-03, 2024-03-03, 2024-03-04, 2024-03-04, 2024-03-05.
    - paid: true, false, true, true, false, true, true, false, true (with neat clean Yes/No or check/cross badges).

Section 2: Columns Schema Configuration:
- Title: 'Schema & Column Settings' (12px uppercase font-semibold tracking-wider text-slate-500 mb-2 mt-4).
- Clean left-aligned table / card list with columns:
  - 'Column Name', 'Data Type', 'Empty Count', 'Distinct Values', 'Sample Values'.
- Exactly 5 rows corresponding to the 5 columns:
  1. order: Type dropdown with 'Integer' selected; Empty count: '0'; Distinct values: '1,000,000'; Sample values: '10001, 10002, 10003...' in tertiary slate.
  2. amount: Type dropdown with 'Decimal' selected; Empty count: '49,912' highlighted in warm amber chip/badge (bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200/60 rounded px-2 py-0.5 font-medium tabular-nums); Distinct values: '184,290'; Sample values: '428.50, 1280.00, 89.90...' in tertiary slate.
  3. region: Type dropdown with 'Text' selected; Empty count: '0'; Distinct values: '5' (with small pill '5'); Sample values: 'EMEA, APAC, Americas, LATAM, MEA' in tertiary slate.
  4. day: Type dropdown with 'Date' selected; Empty count: '30,283' highlighted in warm amber chip/badge (bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200/60 rounded px-2 py-0.5 font-medium tabular-nums); Distinct values: '365'; Sample values: '2024-03-01, 2024-03-02...' in tertiary slate.
  5. paid: Type dropdown with 'Yes/No' selected; Empty count: '0'; Distinct values: '2'; Sample values: 'true, false' in tertiary slate.
- Custom dropdown styled with 10px rounded border, subtle chevron, Inter 13px.

Footer:
- Border top separator rgba(15,23,42,0.08), flex justify-between items-center pt-4 mt-4.
- Left side: Quiet 'Back' pill button (rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors).
- Right side: Primary 'Create table' pill button in omxplorer deep teal (#0e7c86 hover:bg-[#0b6870] text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2) with a crisp table icon (Lucide Table icon).
screens.title: File Import - sales-1m.parquet

outputComponents.text:
I have designed and generated the **omxplorer** file import screen (`File Import - sales-1m.parquet`) matching the specifications and the Liquid design system:

### Key Design Highlights:
1. **Window Backdrop & Atmosphere**:
   - 1440×900 macOS application layout with traffic light controls and the blurred glass control layer (menu bar, toolbar, sheet tabs, and status bar) floating over the sheet.
   - Frosted modal backdrop overlay (`backdrop-blur-md`) providing depth and focus.

2. **Centered 1100×760 Import Dialog**:
   - **Header**: Features the title *"Import sales-1m.parquet"* (22px Inter 700), detailed metadata (*"1,000,000 rows · 5 columns · read in 0.02 s"* with the benchmark highlighted in green), and a 3-step concentric progress pill (`File › Columns › Table`) with the active step *"Columns"* highlighted in deep teal.
   - **Data Preview Grid**: Displays sample rows 1–9 with a row-number gutter, column type badges (`#`, `0.0`, `Aa`, `date`, `bool`), inline mini-distribution sparkline histograms in each header, and visible null/empty amount cell indicators.
   - **Schema & Column Settings**: A clean configuration table for all 5 columns with data type dropdowns, amber alert chips for non-zero empty counts (`49,912` and `30,283`), distinct value metrics (`5` for region), and sample data previews.
   - **Footer Actions**: A quiet `"Back"` pill on the left and a primary `"Create table"` pill in deep teal (`#0e7c86`) with a table icon on the right.

Show the completed step state when 'Create table' is clicked
Simulate changing the 'amount' data type to 'Currency'

- Content layer (solid, opaque): sheet, tables, cards, report page #ffffff. Raised rows / header row #f6f8fb. Hairline rgba(15,23,42,0.07). Strong line rgba(15,23,42,0.14).
- Control layer (glass): toolbar, menu bar, inspector, sheet tabs, status bar, menus, popovers, dialogs: rgba(255,255,255,0.62) with 24px background blur and saturate 1.6, a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.75) rim, a 1px inner top highlight rgba(255,255,255,0.9) and shadow 0 8px 32px rgba(15,23,42,0.10), 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06).
- Ink #0f172a · Body #334155 · Secondary #64748b · Tertiary #94a3b8.
- One accent, omxplorer's deep teal: #0e7c86 (hover #0b6870), wash rgba(14,124,134,0.10), selection fill rgba(14,124,134,0.08), text on accent #ffffff.
- Formula values #6a4fd6. Good #16a34a. Bad #dc2626. Warning #d97706.
- Chart series in order: #0e7c86, #f59e0b, #6366f1, #ec4899, #22c55e, #a16207, #64748b, #c026d3.

## Type
- Inter everywhere (it reads like SF Pro), tabular figures for every number. JetBrains Mono only for formulas and the formula bar.
- 13px body, 12px captions, 11px toolbar labels (500), 15px section titles (600), 22px page titles (700, -0.3px tracking), 34px for the one big number on a tile (650).
- Two weights per screen besides titles: 400 and 500.

## Shape (concentric)
- Window 14px. Floating glass islands 18px with 6px inner padding, so buttons inside are 12px. Cards and report tiles 16px. Menus 14px with 6px padding, items 8px. Inputs and dropdowns 10px. Chips, toggles, segmented thumbs, icon buttons: fully round. Table cells 0; the selection ring 4px.
- Islands float 10px in from the window edges with 10px between them; content scrolls under them.

## Components
- **Menu bar:** a slim glass strip, 13px items, every menu the same type; menus open as one glass panel (never glass on glass: a submenu is a solid white panel), items 30px with icon, label, shortcut right-aligned in tertiary text, a chevron for submenus.
- **Toolbar:** one floating glass island, icon-above-label buttons (18px Lucide icons, 1.5px stroke, 11px labels), groups separated by 12px of space and a faint 1px divider; hover shows a soft round-rect fill; the active tool a teal wash. Left: Save, Undo. Middle: the tab's tools. Right: Format.
- **Grid:** solid white, header row with name, a small round type badge and a tiny histogram; 30px rows; hairlines only horizontal; a row-number gutter in tertiary text; the selected range has a 2px teal ring with 4px corners, a soft teal fill and a small round fill handle; selected column/row headers tinted.
- **Inspector:** a floating glass panel on the right, 300px, a segmented control (glass track, solid white thumb) for its tabs; sections with small uppercase tertiary titles.
- **Sheet tabs and status bar:** one slim glass strip at the bottom: tabs as pills (active pill solid white with a soft shadow), then live figures for the selection (Sum, Average, Count), the GPU chip with a green dot.
- **Dialog / sheet:** a centred solid white panel, 20px radius, large soft shadow, over a dimmed and blurred window; title 17px 600, primary button a teal pill, secondary a quiet pill.
- **Report tile:** a white card, 16px radius, label in secondary text, the big number, the filter as a small chip; tiles sit in a tidy grid of equal widths, the remove button inside the top-right corner, visible on hover.

## Motion (springs, never linear)
- Snappy spring (430 ms) for hover, press (scale 0.96) and toggles; bouncy spring (790 ms) for things that arrive (a menu, a dialog, a new tile); gentle spring (710 ms) for layout changes (the inspector sliding in, tiles reflowing). The selection ring glides between cells.

Desktop screen (1440x900) for 'omxplorer', a first-party Mac-feel data app under the Liquid light theme.

Window background:
- Cool gradient #eef2f7 to #e6ebf2 with top-left macOS window traffic lights (red, yellow, green dots).
- Underneath the modal, the app window is visible but dimmed and frosted with backdrop blur:
  - Top glass menu bar (omxplorer, File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Data, Window, Help) floating 10px in.
  - Floating glass toolbar with Lucide-style icon buttons (Save, Undo, Sort, Filter, Pivot, Chart, Format).
  - Background grid sheet showing faint data table with row numbers, and status bar at bottom with sheet tabs ('Sheet 1', 'Sheet 2') and live figures (Sum, Average, GPU chip with green dot).
  - Semi-transparent backdrop overlay: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.25) with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-md) dimming the background workspace.

Import Modal Dialog:
- Centered solid white floating panel, exactly 1100px wide by 760px high, 20px border radius, crisp 1px border rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), deep soft elevation shadow (0 24px 64px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.22), 0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,0.06)).
- All typography strictly in Inter, with tabular figures for numbers.

Modal Header:
- Top padding, clean flex layout.
- Left side: Title 'Import sales-1m.parquet' (22px Inter, 700 weight, -0.3px tracking, ink #0f172a).
- Subtitle right below: '1,000,000 rows · 5 columns · read in 0.02 s' where 'read in 0.02 s' is in vivid good green (#16a34a) with a small lightning/sparkle or check indicator, and rows/columns in secondary slate (#64748b, 12px Inter tabular figures).
- Right side: Concentric 3-step progress control / breadcrumb pill: 'File › Columns › Table' inside a soft glass/subtle track:
  - Step 1 'File': completed (muted slate with checkmark or quiet icon, #64748b).
  - Divider: '›' (#94a3b8).
  - Step 2 'Columns': CURRENT active step (accentuated pill badge in omxplorer deep teal #0e7c86 with white text, font weight 600, px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs).
  - Divider: '›' (#94a3b8).
  - Step 3 'Table': upcoming step (tertiary text #94a3b8, text-xs).

Section 1: Data Preview Grid (first 9 rows):
- Section label: 'Preview (First 9 rows)' (12px uppercase font-semibold tracking-wider text-slate-500 mb-2).
- Solid white container with 1px border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm.
- Table headers with column names: 'order', 'amount', 'region', 'day', 'paid'.
- Each column header includes:
  - Column name (13px 600 weight Inter).
  - A small concentric type badge next to or under the name:
    - 'order': '#' (integer badge, soft gray wash).
    - 'amount': '0.0' (decimal badge, soft blue/teal wash).
    - 'region': 'Aa' (text badge, soft slate wash).
    - 'day': 'date' (calendar/date icon or 'date' pill).
    - 'paid': 'bool' (toggle/bool badge).
  - A tiny distribution histogram chart right in the header row (32px wide by 12px tall mini sparkline/bars).
- 9 clean rows (32px row height, tabular numbers, Inter 13px, horizontal hairlines rgba(15,23,42,0.07)):
  - Row number gutter in muted tertiary text (1 to 9).
  - Realistic data values:
    - order: 10001, 10002, 10003, 10004, 10005, 10006, 10007, 10008, 10009.
    - amount: $428.50, [empty cell with dashed placeholder or faint amber null pill], $1,280.00, $89.90, [empty cell], $2,450.25, $310.00, $745.10, $512.40.
    - region: 'EMEA', 'APAC', 'Americas', 'EMEA', 'Americas', 'APAC', 'EMEA', 'Americas', 'APAC'.
    - day: 2024-03-01, 2024-03-01, 2024-03-02, 2024-03-02, 2024-03-03, 2024-03-03, 2024-03-04, 2024-03-04, 2024-03-05.
    - paid: true, false, true, true, false, true, true, false, true (with neat clean Yes/No or check/cross badges).

Section 2: Columns Schema Configuration:
- Title: 'Schema & Column Settings' (12px uppercase font-semibold tracking-wider text-slate-500 mb-2 mt-4).
- Clean left-aligned table / card list with columns:
  - 'Column Name', 'Data Type', 'Empty Count', 'Distinct Values', 'Sample Values'.
- Exactly 5 rows corresponding to the 5 columns:
  1. order: Type dropdown with 'Integer' selected; Empty count: '0'; Distinct values: '1,000,000'; Sample values: '10001, 10002, 10003...' in tertiary slate.
  2. amount: Type dropdown with 'Decimal' selected; Empty count: '49,912' highlighted in warm amber chip/badge (bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200/60 rounded px-2 py-0.5 font-medium tabular-nums); Distinct values: '184,290'; Sample values: '428.50, 1280.00, 89.90...' in tertiary slate.
  3. region: Type dropdown with 'Text' selected; Empty count: '0'; Distinct values: '5' (with small pill '5'); Sample values: 'EMEA, APAC, Americas, LATAM, MEA' in tertiary slate.
  4. day: Type dropdown with 'Date' selected; Empty count: '30,283' highlighted in warm amber chip/badge (bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200/60 rounded px-2 py-0.5 font-medium tabular-nums); Distinct values: '365'; Sample values: '2024-03-01, 2024-03-02...' in tertiary slate.
  5. paid: Type dropdown with 'Yes/No' selected; Empty count: '0'; Distinct values: '2'; Sample values: 'true, false' in tertiary slate.
- Custom dropdown styled with 10px rounded border, subtle chevron, Inter 13px.

Footer:
- Border top separator rgba(15,23,42,0.08), flex justify-between items-center pt-4 mt-4.
- Left side: Quiet 'Back' pill button (rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors).
- Right side: Primary 'Create table' pill button in omxplorer deep teal (#0e7c86 hover:bg-[#0b6870] text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2) with a crisp table icon (Lucide Table icon).
rawScreen.title: File Import - sales-1m.parquet
rawScreen.agentText:
I have designed and generated the **omxplorer** file import screen (`File Import - sales-1m.parquet`) matching the specifications and the Liquid design system:

### Key Design Highlights:
1. **Window Backdrop & Atmosphere**:
   - 1440×900 macOS application layout with traffic light controls and the blurred glass control layer (menu bar, toolbar, sheet tabs, and status bar) floating over the sheet.
   - Frosted modal backdrop overlay (`backdrop-blur-md`) providing depth and focus.

2. **Centered 1100×760 Import Dialog**:
   - **Header**: Features the title *"Import sales-1m.parquet"* (22px Inter 700), detailed metadata (*"1,000,000 rows · 5 columns · read in 0.02 s"* with the benchmark highlighted in green), and a 3-step concentric progress pill (`File › Columns › Table`) with the active step *"Columns"* highlighted in deep teal.
   - **Data Preview Grid**: Displays sample rows 1–9 with a row-number gutter, column type badges (`#`, `0.0`, `Aa`, `date`, `bool`), inline mini-distribution sparkline histograms in each header, and visible null/empty amount cell indicators.
   - **Schema & Column Settings**: A clean configuration table for all 5 columns with data type dropdowns, amber alert chips for non-zero empty counts (`49,912` and `30,283`), distinct value metrics (`5` for region), and sample data previews.
   - **Footer Actions**: A quiet `"Back"` pill on the left and a primary `"Create table"` pill in deep teal (`#0e7c86`) with a table icon on the right.
